# aeneid-045 — new house renderings

No new house renderings. No set piece on the pending list falls in VI.509–607.

For the reviewer (not proposed as house renderings): the best-known line of the part, VI.546 *I decus, i, nostrum; melioribus utere fatis!*, was built from the Latin alone:
- `l`: "Go, glory, go, ours; better use fates!”"
- `i`: "On your way, pride of our people, on your way; and may you have the use of kinder fates than mine!”" (reviewer's rephrasing: the drafter's "Go on, glory of our nation, go on" ran close to a well-known version.)
